title: Using Ai to build a town/map
author: No_Swing9502
selftext:
I'm a solo developer working in Unity and Blender, trying to figure out the most efficient way to create a 3D environment using AI.

I already have a top-down satellite-style concept image of a fictional coastal town with roads, buildings, beaches, and terrain.

Ideally, I'd like to use that image as a starting point to generate the basic 3D layout, terrain, buildings, and textures without having to model everything from scratch.

I'm not expecting a one-click solution, just trying to find a workflow that gets me a solid starting point I can refine manually.

Has anyone had success with AI tools, Blender plugins, procedural generation, or image-to-3D workflows for something like this?

I'm relatively new to 3D environment creation, so any recommendations would be appreciated!
